speaker: Ms Rahayu Mahzam
text: asked the Minister for Education whether the interagency task force on Uplifting Pupils in Life and Inspiring Families will be looking at issues affecting older children other than preschool children, and youths in their review of the support in place for students from disadvantaged families.

speaker: The Second Minister for Education (Ms Indranee Rajah) (for the Minister for Education)
text: However, we will also look at other age groups to see how they can be best helped.

speaker: The Second Minister for Education (Ms Indranee Rajah) (for the Minister for Education)
text: The task force has begun engagements with stakeholders who are in the frontline of working with disadvantaged children and their families, including teachers, school personnel, social workers, self-help groups and community partners.

speaker: The Second Minister for Education (Ms Indranee Rajah) (for the Minister for Education)
text: Their experiences and insights will help us to crystallise the issues that need to be addressed and to develop practical strategies and solutions to uplift students of the target profile and help them realise their full potential.
